units.source_text: 有为子刚从女子学校毕业就志愿当了舞鹤海军医院的护土。

en.t: Uiko had just graduated from the girls' school when she volunteered to become a nurse at the Maizuru Naval Hospital.

units.source_text: 她家离医院不远，可以骑自行车上班。

en.t: Her house was not far from the hospital, so she could commute to work by bicycle.

units.source_text: 每天她都在拂晓时分离家去上班，比我们上学的时间还早两个多小时。

en.t: Every day she left home for work at daybreak, more than two hours earlier than the time when we went to school.
